profile.headline: Software Engineer at KeyW Corporation
profile.summary:
Consultant with more than ten years of experience in mission-critical, real-time systems.  Expertise in J2EE, Java, Portal, Web application and Web site design and development with an emphasis on web standards and usability.

U.S. Citizen with an active security clearance with polygraph.

Specialties: application and portal development, information architecture, technical architecture, portal and content management, interaction design, usability, accessibility, web standards

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Enterprise Management Lead (October 2011 – October 2012)
- Represented the client Program in various meetings related to the Enterprise business practices and Enterprise Management (EM) for system availability, event/performance monitoring, and end user experience
- Engaged with Enterprise IT senior leadership to set direction of the EM strategy by identifying gaps of current technology and supporting infrastructure services
- Responded to white paper requests and provided technical architecture refresh recommendations for leading EM tools and products

Operations & Sustainment (O&S) Upgrades – Systems Engineering Lead (October 2012 – October 2013)
- Manage project plan and integration with Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), track budget, and allocate resources for O&S Upgrades for more than 50 customer entities across 4 technical teams (Compute, Database, Networks, and Storage) on 7 customer enclaves / networks
- Manage ITIL Service Transition process and Service Request Management redesign, support infrastructure change management, and lead Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs) with senior leadership and technical teams to facilitate requirements elicitation, define technical architecture solution for infrastructure migration, create budgetary estimates, and schedule customer transitions into the Data Center
- Provide weekly project status, resource forecasting, and risk management to senior leadership team

SharePoint Manager (October 2011 – October 2013)
- Effectively led a team of SharePoint specialists to gather requirements, estimate, plan, and execute Sprints using Agile software development methodology in maintaining a program-wide SharePoint Portal
- Chaired the SharePoint Requirements Board and lead TEMs to re-engineer business processes 
- Drove technical architecture design, implementation, and successful customer migration onto a SharePoint 2010 Common Service offering

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: IT Manager at Accenture, specializing in Enterprise Management, Portals, and Information Management.

positions.title: Usability Engineer
positions.description:
- Expert in human-computer, user-centered, and user interface design; key contributor with UI standards and CSS definition
- Breadth of knowledge with Web 2.0, portal, and mobile technologies
- Support work across multiple teams and releases to address usability considerations using Waterfall and Agile Scrum development methodologies
- Extensive interaction with key stakeholders in gathering requirements, designing wireframes, and rapidly prototyping new functionality using (X)HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Developed front-end user interface components 
- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop for web graphics production, image optimization, and image editing; proficient with image sprite creation

positions.title: Portal Architect and Developer
positions.description:
- Key contributor to quality and process improvement (QPI) for the project, including processes for documentation standards, issue tracking, configuration management, project planning, and requirements traceability, using the Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) Framework
- Responsible for requirements elicitation, technical architecture design, development, testing, and deployment of IBM Websphere Portal and Oracle Universal Content Management (Stellent) system using industry standards (JSTL, Spring MVC, Hibernate, IBM Portal API)
- Responsible for providing technical support, triaging, analyzing audit data, and resolving production problems in conjunction with off-site Release Management team

positions.title: Lead Java Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for the operations and maintenance of the agency's Intranet Web site and design and development of the agency's AssuranceNet management control web application.  
- Drove the design and development of the Web site / application’s JSP pages, input forms, feedback form using Java Mail API and SMTP server, cascading style sheets (CSS), application security, Hibernate persistence layer, the business logic layer and DAOs
- Responsible for build and deployment of EAR file on WAS application server as well as configurations on WAS, such as JAAS DataSource configurations and JDBC setup
- Helped integrate web application with Business Objects Crystal Reports

positions.title: Performance Test Lead
positions.description:
- Led test coordination, test script and test plan creation, and performance testing (Mercury LoadRunner) of the agency's Web site, including compliance with Section 508
- Designed Web graphics using Adobe Photoshop and managed content using Oracle (Stellent) CMS

positions.title: Lead Java Developer
positions.description:
- Drove design and development using GOTS/Struts framework (Java classes, JSP pages, CSS, SQL stored procedures, XML parsing) of a mobile application for training users on how to use the asset tracking and handling SV application 
- Responsible for technical designs (use cases, class/sequence diagrams), user guides, UI standards, and training materials

positions.title: Business Analyst / UI and SQL Developer
positions.description:
- Defined and developed a defect tracking and problem management tool in Rational ClearQuest
- Worked with key stakeholders to gather requirements, to design wireframes, to produce high-fidelity prototypes (HTML/CSS/JSP), to develop complex SQL stored procedures for mapping to the business logic, and for integration testing of a custom Billing and Rates Web application

positions.title: User Interface (UI) Developer
positions.description:
- Coordinated migration of disparate, division intranet websites to a consolidated, Intranet Portal site (Vignette)
- Responsible for content management (Vignette), content migration, Web development (HTML, CSS, ColdFusion), and Web graphic production (Adobe Photoshop) for Caterpillar Intranet Portal
- Worked with Lean Six Sigma champions to identify process improvements for migration to Intranet Portal
